findings.text: Real time join and leave handling refreshes execution accounting and wait statistics, inserts or removes the scheduling entity from its queue, and maintains membership in the migratable pushable set for multi CPU tasks while leaving blocked tasks out of that set.

Wait time statistics for real time entities are collected only when global scheduling statistics are active and a statistics record can be resolved from the entity, distinguishing task entities from group entities when attributing the sample to a task.

Bandwidth disable and enable walk every real time queue of a run queue while the scheduler is running, holding the global bandwidth lock outside the per queue runtime lock, and disable reclaims lent time from other CPUs before marking the local queue unlimited and clearing its throttle flag and re exposing it to selection.
One build configuration provides empty runtime enable and disable operations that leave run queue state untouched, expressing that bandwidth control is compiled out.

A throttled queue reports throttled without further checks, an unlimited queue never throttles, and a limited queue that has consumed more than its allotted time moves to throttled and is removed from scheduling when its bandwidth allocation is nonzero, while a zero allocation queue instead resets its consumed time and stays runnable.

Execution time charging applies only when the donor task belongs to the real time class and positive time elapsed, and under group scheduling it adds that delta to each ancestor queue with finite bandwidth, requesting rescheduling and arming replenishment when a queue becomes over budget.

Requeueing moves an already queued entity to the front or back of its priority list, task level requeue repeats this across all ancestor entities, and yielding places the current donor at the tail to give peers a chance.

Wakeup and fork placement may redirect a real time task away from its initial CPU toward a lower priority run queue when the local run queue holds a real time donor and priority or capacity conditions suggest imbalance, otherwise the task stays on the requested CPU.

Lowest run queue search fails for single CPU tasks or missing scratch state, builds a low priority candidate mask with capacity awareness on asymmetric systems, prefers the previous CPU when eligible, then scans wake affine domains favoring the waking CPU before falling back to any candidate.

Real time wakeup preemption applies only when both newcomer and donor are real time, preempts immediately on strictly higher priority, and on equal priority may reschedule to push the current migratable task away when the newcomer cannot migrate and no reschedule is already pending.

Task selection reports empty when nothing is queued, otherwise descends from the root queue through the highest priority entity at each level until reaching a task, while entering and leaving a task updates wait statistics and load signals and removes or restores pushable eligibility.

Pushable handling keeps an ordered set per run queue, highest pushable lookup returns the first entry allowed on a given CPU, next pushable lookup skips tasks still on CPU or with migration disabled, and several consistency properties are asserted such as queued state and real time class.

Pulling on an overloaded domain skips work when idle or sole overloaded, optionally delegates to a push wakeup, otherwise scans overloaded peers in order, skipping those whose next priority cannot preempt locally, and under paired run queue locks migrates a higher priority pushable task or asks a migration disabled task to be pushed, then requests rescheduling if anything moved.

Overload push initiation allows a single starter through an atomic guard, records progress under a domain lock while skipping the initiator, wraps with a generation counter that observes concurrent requests, and holds a domain reference while queueing work to the next overloaded CPU.
The run queue iterator type is a plain pointer to a real time run queue, used to walk all such queues belonging to one CPU run queue.
The bound on repeated real time balancing attempts is three.
Per CPU scratch CPU mask storage backs lowest run queue search and the search aborts when that storage is not yet available.
Domain lifetime helper acquires one reference on a root domain so asynchronous push work cannot observe a freed domain.

A run queue counts as real time runnable when its queued count is positive, and the periodic real time balance step first attempts a pull when the donor is absent from its queue and then reports whether stop, deadline or real time work remains.

Bandwidth disable warns if reclamation leaves any wanted time outstanding, signalling leaked time, and push and pull paths assert task placement and queue membership properties whose violation indicates corrupted scheduler state.

Wakeup placement and lowest CPU search use read side critical sections around unlocked donor reads and domain walks, pull pairs run queue locks across source and destination with drops around stop work, and periodic balancing temporarily unpins its run queue lock while pulling.
